'''Transponder dishes''' were portable communications [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. They were used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in conjunction with [[crosslink beam emitter]]s during a deployment on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to scan local [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace]] and [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] frequencies.
